capabilities: Embed vault-local .html files inline using wikilink syntax or an html-embed code block
Run embedded pages in a sandboxed iframe with scripts but no access to Obsidian's DOM or vault
Resolve embed paths through Obsidian's link resolver so embeds survive vault moves
Set embed height via |number syntax or a height option in the code block
extras: Desktop only (manifest marks isDesktopOnly). Embedded HTML must be self-contained: relative images, external CSS/JS and fonts will not load. Installable via BRAT from the GitHub repo. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README advises embedding only HTML files you trust.
intentEvidence: Obsidian embeds notes, images and PDFs, but an .html file in your vault is only a file you can open.
problem: Obsidian embeds notes, images and PDFs, but an .html file in the vault can only be opened as a file, not rendered inline with its JavaScript running.
summary: Embeds a vault-local HTML file in a note as a sandboxed iframe via ![[file.html]] or an html-embed code block.
